observation.initial_state: A rectangular glass aquarium is filled with water, featuring a substrate of pink cylindrical gravel. Several orange goldfish are swimming in the tank; one large fish is near the center, another on the left, and smaller ones are scattered around. Decorations include a white statue on the left, a red windmill in the center, a cat figurine on the right, and a tall green plant. A black corrugated tube (filter intake) stands vertically on the right side. Bubbles are rising from an aerator near the top center.
visible_changes: Throughout the clip, the goldfish swim slowly around the tank. The large central fish drifts slightly to the left and then back towards the center. The fish on the far left remains relatively stationary near the white statue.
The smaller fish near the top left moves slightly downwards and to the right.
Bubbles continuously rise from the aerator at the top, creating a stream of small spheres moving upwards through the water column.
The camera angle remains static throughout the sequence, providing a consistent view of the tank's interior.
There is no significant change in lighting or water clarity.
observation.final_state: The scene remains largely unchanged from the start. The goldfish have shifted positions slightly due to their swimming but remain within the same general areas. The bubbles continue to rise. The overall composition of the tank and its decorations is identical to the initial state.
